## P26 â€” full current-main reconciliation, Draft only

### Root cause
After P25 moved five *unapplied* creative SQL proposals out of the canonical migration root, its GitHub Migration Guard and Atlas Project Isolation CI turned GREEN. **Vercel still failed** because the integration branch carried an old 101/87 migrations baseline, while the real production ledger already contains `survival_threshold_status_canonical`. That migration is included in `origin/main`, which has **151 canonical / 137 enforced** migrations. P25 and main diverged by ~524 main-only commits; whitelisting one new migration would be a misleading, unsafe partial fix.

### What changed
- Built a fresh isolated worktree from P25 and merged a pinned `origin/main` at **`11b7433c259829c64857fa609a738ef8163889b1`**. Read-only `git merge-tree` and actual two-parent merge reported **no Git conflicts**. Merge commit `0a0a58c` has parents P25 `3386be7` and main `11b7433`.
- The resulting tree has original current-main Guard v2 and **151/151 canonical SQL migrations**, **137 enforced**, and still has exactly **five quarantined, byte-identical creative migration prototypes** under `apps/web/supabase/creative-drafts/` (unapplied).
- Updated P25's **isolated test only** to pin the latest main 151/137 baseline. **No modifications to Guard v2 production policy, frozen ledger lists, classification registry, SQL permissions, media execution flags, P0 worker security, or actual production database.**

### Verification
- New P26 draft isolation tests **3/3 passed**; merged creative Node suite **288/288 passed** serially.
- Not run locally: PGlite/PG17 staging, full Next.js build or complete app tests, due to Hultgren having under ~1 GB RAM free. New GitHub CI and Vercel build **must** prove this reconciled tree and any remaining failures must be investigated.
- This PR does NOT address P25's separate SDF-1C Docker test **5-second timeout** (361/362 tests passed there); no relaxation or forced rerun of that security test was performed.

### NO GO
- This is a LARGE main compatibility merge, NOT proof that Atlas is ready for creative execution. Keep Draft; no merge to main, Supabase migration application, OS worker activation, editor process, publication or paid cloud service creation.
- Worker `omnira-media-worker` remains DISABLED. Coordinate main/P0 owners and independently validate all resulting integrations.

Documentation: `docs/ATLAS_CREATIVE_P26_CURRENT_MAIN_RECONCILIATION.md`.

## Confirmed CI and preview outcome (2026-10-21)

- âœ… **All 9/9 GitHub Actions workflow runs completed SUCCESS** on head commit `059efe2137910683fdd6b649ed41b4c10646dc57`: Trading Canon Integrity, Atlas Project Isolation, Migration Guard Integrity, Atlas Studio Responsive UI, SDF-1C Trusted Broker Boundary, Handlarborsen Weekly Report, SDF-1B Control Plane Boundary, Atlas Dream Reconciliation Boundary and Memory M4 Boundary.
- âœ… **Vercel preview deployment `dpl_uYfph8UNzJM9PLMWhEz1etFBTrXn` reported READY.** Vercel migration guard logged `137/137 enforced migrations applied; 174 unique known ledger names`. The previous P25 `survival_threshold_status_canonical` unknown-ledger failure is no longer present.
- âœ… Serial P26 creative Node tests **288/288**, P26 migration quarantine guard **3/3** (included within 288).
- **Not yet validated:** P26 merged-tree PGlite/real PG17 creative SQL suites or actual Windows media isolation/activation; keep Draft and do NOT deploy/migrate creative drafts or enable media worker. Next is review of integration with real restricted worker test environment.
